BiblicalUsage: Paul says he suffered all things lest he should hinder the gospel of Christ in 1 Corinthians 9:12 — he gave up his right to support so that nothing would stand in the gospel's way.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gospel is worth any sacrifice of my rights, and the question I should ask of every privilege is whether it helps the gospel or hinders it.
